author: emilizzle
body:
Hello all!

So, I'm establishing my own (unofficial) TDM team. We've 4 members right now (including me) and we are looking for new trials with experience in TDM (not only 1 hit TDM). We've an (outdated) server and a team that can sub whenever we need a sub. 

Our goal is to get a team with 10 - 15 members and to scrim top teams on TDM. You can be part of any team on any server, this team won't exist on Avicus, OCN or other servers.
